set_aside.subject: precedence between a later NodeExecution and an older not_applied attempt
set_aside.text: or not reached when no approval of the element is requested and it either has no NodeExecution yet or its latest attempt the owner resolved `not_applied`
set_aside.question: If an attempt was resolved `not_applied` and the subsequent reach produced a later `operation_failed` or `refused_by_owner` NodeExecution without leaving an approval in `requested` status, is the element failed/refused or `not reached`?
options: The later NodeExecution determines the conclusion; `not reached` applies only when nothing later has concluded the element.
`not reached` takes precedence whenever the latest EffectAttempt was resolved `not_applied` and no approval is currently `requested`.
Define “latest attempt” relative to the latest NodeExecution so the resolved attempt stops qualifying after any later execution record.
set_aside.default_guess: The later NodeExecution determines the conclusion, and the `not reached` condition applies only when no later NodeExecution concludes the element.
